concerns.text: Tasks T018 and T019 (subject filtering) depend on T020 (standardized logging), but T020 depends on T018/T019 to be invoked. This circular dependency prevents the implementation of FR-009 (logging exclusion decisions). The task list claims to satisfy FR-009 but structurally blocks the required logging mechanism.

Task T027 (run_permutation_test) and T040 (unit tests) are marked as 'REJECTED' in the provided context, yet the task list presents them as completed `[X]`. This creates a semantic gap where FR-006 (10,000 permutation tests) and SC-001 (report p-value) are claimed to be satisfied by tasks that are explicitly non-functional or missing.

Tasks T022 and T023 (plot generation) are marked 'REJECTED' in the context, yet listed as `[X]`. Furthermore, T057 mandates raising a `CriticalError` if image compression fails to meet the 5MB limit. This violates the spec's edge case handling (which implies skipping/logging, not halting the pipeline) and contradicts SC-004 (plots must be saved without errors).

Tasks T017 and T017.1 (reporting Pearson r and ΔR²) are marked 'REJECTED' in the context, yet listed as `[X]`. This means the deliverable for FR-005 (regression output) and SC-003 (ΔR² precision) is missing, creating a false claim of constraint satisfaction.

Task T046 (sensitivity analysis) is marked 'REJECTED' in the context, yet listed as `[X]`. Consequently, FR-010 (sensitivity sweep) and SC-002/SC-005 (sensitivity table) are not actually covered by a functional task, violating the requirement that tasks must deliver the spec's acceptance criteria.
